title: VeryEasyBoard
description: Even your dog can handle this plugin! The lightweight Scoreboard & TAB solution
body:
**⚡ VeryEasyBoard**

**Simple Scoreboard & TAB. No BS. No Headache.**

Bro! I spent half an hour writing this plugin so you could set up your Scoreboard and TAB in 5 minutes.

Seriously. Why waste your life on plugins with 2000-line configs just to show a ping and a server name? VeryEasyBoard is the goat. Zero bloat, zero trash-just stuff that works.

**🚀 Why you actually need this:**

**Zero Braincells Required:** Setup so easy, even your dog could do it.

**Lightweight AF:** This plugin weighs less than a screenshot of your desktop. Your server won't even feel it.

**PlaceholderAPI Support:** Want to show balance? Playtime? Zombie kills? PAPI's got you, and we’ve got PAPI.

**Instant Reload:** Edit the config, type /veb reload - and BAM! Updates instantly.

**🛠 Setup (Easier than making a sandwich):**

Drop it into plugins.

Install PlaceholderAPI (don't live in the Stone Age, man).

Open **config.yml**, throw in some colors.

Go play.

**📜 Commands:**

/veb reload - The only command you’ll ever actually need.
